sources.title: IBM details how Granite 4.2 was built: dense 3B, 8B and 30B models with ...
sources.snippet: IBM has published a detailed account of how its Granite 4.2 language models were built, in a post on the Hugging Face blog dated 25 August 2026. The release comprises three dense, decoder-only models at 3, 8 and 30 billion parameters, licensed under Apache 2.0 and available on Hugging Face and GitHub, with quantised variants in FP8, FP4 and GGUF formats.
